PASS.label: Passed
PASS.meaning: This check was carried out and the result is within the agreed limits.

WARNING.label: Needs review
WARNING.meaning: This check was carried out and the result is outside the comfortable range, but not far enough to be treated as a failure. Someone should look at it.

FAIL.label: Action needed
FAIL.meaning: This check was carried out and the result is outside the agreed limits. It needs investigation.

PENDING.label: Not measured
PENDING.meaning: This check could not be carried out, so there is no result. This is not a pass — nothing has been verified.

EVIDENCE_MISSING.label: Awaiting Organizational Evidence
EVIDENCE_MISSING.meaning: This regulatory requirement applies, but proving it needs records only your organisation holds — for example board minutes, contracts or due-diligence files. The platform cannot see those, so it makes no judgement.

NOT_ASSESSED.label: Not assessed
NOT_ASSESSED.meaning: No assessment was made. Either the requirement does not apply here, or not enough was declared to decide.

APPLICABILITY_UNCLEAR.label: Applicability unclear
APPLICABILITY_UNCLEAR.meaning: We cannot tell whether this requirement applies to you, because the organisation details it depends on were not provided. Nothing is assumed either way.

NOT_APPLICABLE.label: Does not apply
NOT_APPLICABLE.meaning: Based on the organisation details provided, this requirement does not apply to you. It is listed so nothing is silently hidden.

APPLIES.label: Applies to you
APPLIES.meaning: Based on the organisation details provided, this requirement applies to you.

PARTIAL.label: Partly met
PARTIAL.meaning: Some, but not all, of what this requirement asks for was evidenced.

RETRIEVED.label: Source found
RETRIEVED.meaning: A verified regulatory source was found and is quoted alongside this section.

NOT_FOUND.label: No source found
NOT_FOUND.meaning: No verified regulatory source was found in the material currently loaded. This does not mean no rule exists — it means we will not quote one we have not verified.

COMPARABLE.label: Safe to compare
COMPARABLE.meaning: These two results were measured the same way, so comparing them is meaningful.

NOT_COMPARABLE.label: Not safe to compare
NOT_COMPARABLE.meaning: These two results were measured over different things, so putting them side by side would be misleading. The comparison is withheld rather than shown with a caveat.

computed.label: Measured
computed.meaning: This value was calculated from real model output.

unavailable_no_scores.label: Not available
unavailable_no_scores.meaning: This model does not produce probability scores, so this particular measure could not be calculated. The other measures were still taken.
